figures.caption: Avoidance of Incumbent Pairings in South Pasadena, CA. figures.label: Figure 2
figures.caption: Location of the Adopted Plan’s Proportion Alone in the City’s Simulation c Distribution of Proportion Alone . This histogram shows the distribution of percentiles c of Proportion Alone within cities’ own simulation distributions of the same metric, de- c fined as the number of incumbents assigned to their own district divided by the number of incumbents on the council at the time the city switched to district elections. Red dashed line is at the median (100) and blue dotted line is at the mean (89).

figures.label: Figure 3
figures.caption: Simulation Distributions of Proportion Alone . Summary statistics of the c distributions of Proportion Alone over simulated plans in every city, defined as the c number of incumbents assigned to their own district divided by the number of incum- bents on the council at the time the city switched to district elections. Thin black lines span the range of the simulation distribution. Thick black lines span the 25th to 75th per- centiles of the simulation distribution—if omitted, this indicates that the range collapses to the median value. Black points represent the median of the simulation distribution.
